about: LGIC_CANON round 1: the canonical answer to each item of CN_NAMING_JOB.json, for each job, surface and slot (DEC-5, slot-aware). Cited only by CN-n-3's face and by check_canon_r1.py n3-*. The naming workers (CN-n-1, CN-n-2) are told not to read this file.
derivation: Each value is the builder's own output, never typed: lib/opal_naming.py key(), address() and name(), and the bucket field of infra/logic/registry/scopes.json row 49financial (long 49financial, short 49f, class FIRM), called at the issuance base CLOUD @10894fdad1 (registry scopes.json @a925c8a642, NAMING_SCHEMA.json v1.8 @2f554182b6). NAMING_SCHEMA v1.9 moves firm_forms into the registry (GROUP V19); the 49financial/49f values are the same in both carriers, so no value here moves with it.
slots: LONG form 49financial in a bucket name and in a key's scope segment; SHORT form 49f in a resource name's scope slot. bd is refused in every slot; the vendor is blackdiamond.

n6.trap_is: the refused token bd (the vendor's old spelling, and 49 Financial's legacy bucket spelling) in either slot, or the LONG form 49financial in the resource scope slot
